item: 1. Shanghai Fengxian Haiwan Expansion: offshore or seawall/onshore?
farm: Shanghai Fengxian Haiwan Expansion Offshore wind farm
proposal: (lead) if accepted: fix('CHN', 'Shanghai Fengxian Haiwan Expansion Offshore wind farm', G, '上海市發改委 2023-07 陸上風電與光伏電站開發建設項目清單把同一業主（上海新能源環保工程有限公司）的「奉賢海灣風電場改造升級」4.8 萬瓩列為陸上風電；這筆是同一座奉賢海灣風電場的 14.75 MW 擴容（財政部 2013-03 補助目錄），沒有任何出處說機組在海上，改為陸域', 'The Shanghai DRC list of onshore wind and solar projects (July 2023) puts the repowering of the same Fengxian Haiwan wind farm (owner Shanghai New Energy & Environmental Protection Engineering, 48 MW) under onshore wind; this record is the 14.75 MW expansion of that farm (Ministry of Finance subsidy catalogue, March 2013), and no source places any of its turbines at sea, so it becomes onshore', 'https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/fgw_ny/20230713/489709e3eb964cf79f9d138ff6ed31a2.html', type=0)
note_zh: 新證據（官方）：上海市發改委 2023-07-10《上海市2023年陸上風電和光伏電站開發建設項目清單》第 2 項「奉賢區 奉賢海灣風電場改造升級 上海新能源環保工程有限公司 陸上風電 4.8 前期」——同一業主、同一座「奉賢海灣風電場」被歸為陸上風電。這筆 GEM 紀錄是該風電場的 14.75 MW 擴容（財政部 2013-03 補助目錄名稱「奉賢海灣風電場擴容14.75MW發電工程」）。強烈指向陸域（海堤上），但仍沒有出處直接寫擴容的機組位置；GEM 的「海上」與概略點都只引 CDM 5636 號（cdm.unfccc.int 機器人牆，讀不到 PDD）。主對話若接受「同一風電場＝陸上」的推論，可改 type=0。
note_en: New official evidence: the Shanghai DRC list of 10 July 2023 (onshore wind and solar projects) has item 2 “Fengxian district – Fengxian Haiwan wind farm repowering – Shanghai New Energy & Environmental Protection Engineering Co – onshore wind – 4.8 (10 MW) – pre-construction”: the same owner’s same “Fengxian Haiwan wind farm” is classed as onshore wind. This GEM record is that farm’s 14.75 MW expansion (Ministry of Finance subsidy catalogue: “Fengxian Haiwan wind farm expansion 14.75 MW”). This points strongly to onshore (on the sea wall), but no source states where the expansion’s turbines stand; GEM’s ‘offshore’ and its approximate point both cite only CDM project 5636 (cdm.unfccc.int bot wall, PDD unreadable). If the main session accepts ‘same farm = onshore’, set type=0.
why: No document describes the expansion's turbine positions. Blocked: cdm.unfccc.int (Incapsula; grab_page returns 1 char; WebFetch empty), mp.weixin.qq.com (GEM's source for the 62.5 MW repowering), Overpass API mirrors (timeouts/reset). Web-search budget ran out before the UNEP DTU / IGES CDM databases could be tried.

note_zh: 仍查不到六鰲 E 區的官方座標。福建省自然資源廳的用海批覆檢索（was5 API，標題含「漳浦」「六鳌」）只有六鰲二期的用海與變更批覆、漁港與碼頭，沒有 E 區的用海預審或批覆；漳州市政府附件（六鰲二期變更論證報告書，可能列出周邊 D/E/F 區位置）與世紀新能源網的 E 區頁都連不上。GEM 的 22.733 N、118.033 E 仍無出處可核對，不臆測。
note_en: Still no official position for Liu'ao area E. The Fujian natural-resources department's approval search (was5 API, titles with 漳浦/六鳌) returns only the Liu'ao phase 2 sea-use approval and its change, plus fishing ports and quays; nothing for area E. The Zhangzhou government attachment (Liu'ao phase 2 change report, which may map the neighbouring D/E/F areas) and the chinawindnews E-area page are unreachable. GEM's 22.733 N, 118.033 E still cannot be checked; no guess.
why: Blocked: www.zhangzhou.gov.cn attachments (connection reset; 503 over http), chinawindnews.com (31-char page), oss.fjhb.org, web.archive.org (earlier rounds). No sea-use, EIA or MSA document for area E found; web-search budget exhausted.

item: 3a. Changle Waihai A vs C: zone of the first Dongfang 10 MW unit (5 Aug 2021, hub 118 m)
farm: CTG Fujian Changle Waihai A / Changle Waihai C
proposal: (no dimensions rule: the zone is not settled from a quotable source, and in either zone the 118 m hub would cover only the Dongfang 10 MW units, not every unit)
note_zh: 仍是線索、但更接近 A 區：搜尋結果中北極星 2021-09-08〈長樂外海海上風電場C區項目首台10MW風機完成吊裝〉寫 C 區第一台東方 10 MW 是 9 月 4 日才吊裝（C 區 10 MW 輪轂約距海面 120 m）；若屬實，8 月 5 日那台（118 m）只可能在 A 區。但北極星頁面在這裡讀不到（空白），不能引用。不論哪一區，該區都混裝不同機型（A 區 37 部含 10 部東方 10 MW；C 區 37 部上海電氣 8 MW＋20 部東方 10 MW），118 m 不適用全場，所以不構成尺寸資料。
note_en: Still a lead, now leaning to area A: in search results, bjx (8 Sept 2021, ‘first 10 MW turbine of Changle Waihai area C installed’) says area C's first Dongfang 10 MW unit was only installed on 4 Sept (its 10 MW hubs about 120 m above sea level); if so, the 5 Aug unit (118 m hub) can only be in area A. The bjx page reads as empty here and cannot be quoted. Either way both zones mix models (A: 37 units incl. 10 Dongfang 10 MW; C: 37 Shanghai Electric 8 MW + 20 Dongfang 10 MW), so 118 m does not apply to a whole farm and gives no dimensions row.
why: bjx.com.cn pages return an empty shell (404 chars); imarine.cn 403; eworldship.com TLS (DH key too small); csdn 521. No quotable page names the zone of the 5 Aug 2021 installation.

item: 4. Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua): fully connected, and when?
farm: Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm
proposal: (lead) if accepted: fix('CHN', 'Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm', G, '威海市委對外宣傳辦（2024-10-29）：山東半島南 U 場址（150 萬瓩，含國家能源集團 U2 的 60 萬瓩）2024-10-26 實現全容量併網；國家能源集團 2025-09：U2 安裝 71 台 8.5 MW、603.5 MW，2025-08-28 全容量登記 CCER', 'Weihai municipal publicity office (29 Oct 2024): the Peninsula South U site (1,500 MW, including CHN Energy’s 600 MW U2) reached full grid connection on 26 Oct 2024; CHN Energy (Sept 2025): U2 has 71 × 8.5 MW installed, 603.5 MW, registered at full capacity for CCER on 28 Aug 2025', 'https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_29177936', st=0, year=2024, turbine='71x Envision EN226-8.5')
note_zh: 仍無 U2 自己的全容量併網公告，但官方說法增加：(1) 威海市委對外宣傳辦官方澎湃號「威海發布」2024-10-29：U 場址 150 萬瓩（U1 90 萬＋U2 60 萬）「實現全容量併網發電」；(2) 山東改革創新者說（搜狐 2024-12）：U 場址共安裝 177 台（106＋71），10 月 26 日全容量併網。反證仍是中證鵬元 2025-06 評級報告把 U2 一、二期列在 2024 年末「在建、擬建」（各剩 0.74、0.63 億元投資，可能只是未轉固／未決算）與山東 2025 年重點項目名單。U 場址的兩份說法都是以 U1 二期 2024-10-26 併網為準的整體宣布，U2 沒有自己的日期，維持線索；主對話若接受官方整體說法，可改營運中 2024。
note_en: Still no U2-specific full-connection notice, but more official statements: (1) ‘Weihai Release’, the Weihai municipal publicity office's official channel (29 Oct 2024): the 1,500 MW U site (U1 900 MW + U2 600 MW) “reached full grid connection”; (2) Shandong ‘reform innovators’ series (Sohu, Dec 2024): the U site has 177 turbines (106 + 71) and was fully connected on 26 Oct. Against: the June 2025 CSCI Pengyuan rating report still lists U2 phases 1 and 2 as ‘under construction or planned’ at end-2024 (CNY 74 m and 63 m left, possibly just not yet capitalised), and Shandong's 2025 key-project list. Both U-site statements are site-wide announcements keyed to U1 phase 2's connection on 26 Oct 2024; U2 has no date of its own, so it stays a lead. If the main session accepts the official site-wide statement, set operating 2024.
why: No U2-specific grid-connection report from CHN Energy/Guohua/Shandong energy bureau found; ccer.cets.org.cn needs login; web-search budget exhausted.

note_zh: 建成但未見併入公用電網：2022-06 在湛江羅鬥沙海域（瓊州海峽東口、平均水深 65 m）完成安裝，6.2 MW、半潛式；國防科工局轉中國船舶 2023-08：「扶搖號」在智能微網模式下運行發電（離網），2022 年已「具備並網的工程技術條件」，微網運行是「為正式並網運行做好充分準備」——即到 2023-08 尚未正式併網。之後查不到正式併網報導。位置只有「羅鬥沙海域」，沒有官方座標。資料庫沒有任何紀錄。

近日，中国船舶集团旗下中船海装 “扶摇号”浮式风电装备在智能微网模式下成功运行发电。
2022年，中船海装按计划完成了浮式风电装备关键技术研究、浮式风电装备制造、工程主体及海缆施工等系列工作，让“扶摇号”具备了并网的工程技术条件。
为“扶摇号”的正式并网运行做好了充分准备
